title: 3CE 口红怎么涂出柔和渐变？
summary:
原视频简介给了三步：
① 把 #212 MOON 涂在嘴唇内侧。
② 轻轻抿唇，让颜色贴合。
③ 用棉签、手指或唇刷，从内向外晕开。

重点是内深外浅，唇缘留得柔和一点。

description:
December is the party month. This is definitely one of the reasons that we want to try something different to stand out in the crowd. Thinking of creating a trendy k-pop look with gradient lips but don't know where to start from? Stop stressing, we are here to help. Here are some tips on how you can create the cute dolly gradient lips look using 3CE Red Recipe #212 MOON. 

1. Apply 3CE Red Recipe #MOON on the inner part of your lips 
2. Gently press your lips together for better adhesion and long lasting effect 
3. Daub from the inner part of your lip using a cotton bud , finger or lip brush to the outer part of your lips to create soft and gradient effect.
4. Lastly, don't forget to take a selfie! 

Now, you are ready to rock the PARTAAAY. Share with us on how you did your gradient lip make up by hashtagging us in your post #UrcosmeMy
